meta.title: Paseo Hub
meta.description: Connect this DSH Host to Paseo Hub as a daemon. Open Paseo Hub in the sidebar, enter the Hub address, and approve the sign-in in the browser. Hub triggers from GitHub, Slack, Discord, Linear, and Telegram then run as DSH sessions with the provider `dsh`, your models, and your permission presets as modes. Each run gets Hub's reply and finish tools, preapproved for that session only. Runs only while this Host is running.
